description.value:
You learn to blend hemocraft and profane magic together, using one pool of dark power to feed the other. You gain an additional use of your Blood Maledict feature.

Additionally, you can expend uses of your Blood Maledict to cast Warlock spells and Pact Magic spell slots to use Blood Curses as per the table below. This feature allows you to cast Pact Magic spells at a lower level than you currently have access to, but not higher. If you use a Blood Curse by expending a Pact Magic spell slot, any excess uses generated are regained instead. If you amplify a Blood Curse used in this manner, you do not roll separately for the hit point cost and gain, they nullify each other at a 1:1 ratio.

Accursed Magick Conversion
Pact Magic Spell SlotBlood Maledict Cost/Regain
1st1 use
2nd1 use + hit point cost for amplifying 1 blood curse
3rd2 uses
4th2 uses + hit point cost for amplifying 2 blood curses
